info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Airline Flights Miles-v3-spec
info.description: The Airline Flight Mileage Retrieval API provides the capability to access the mileage details associated with various airline flights. Users can retrieve comprehensive distance information for flights offered by different airlines, supporting travel planning and rewards tracking. This API is particularly useful for travel agencies, airline partners, and frequent travelers who need to calculate distances for loyalty programs or travel itineraries. By integrating this API, developers can enhance their applications with valuable flight mileage data.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve information about available flight miles associated with their account. It provides details that can help users understand their mileage balance and usage options.

requestBody.description: This request body must include the necessary criteria for retrieving mile information for flights. Ensure that all required parameters are specified according to the API's specifications.

ListAirlineFlightsMilesRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on flights regarding miles. It is expected to be a string that can contain specific information related to the flight miles request.
